summary: The customer called because they had an emergency and could not pay their monthly bill on time. The agent verified the account, confirmed the bill amount of seventy dinars and the due date, and granted a ten-day extension until the 25th of the month without any extra charges. The agent confirmed that an SMS confirmation would be sent, and successfully closed the call.
